title: Minimum Interval Selection to Cover Target Intervals
statement: The task is to choose the fewest closed intervals from availableIntervals covering every real point of targetIntervals, or report -1, with up to 5·10^4 intervals and endpoints up to 10^5. Only the targets' union matters, and real points mean consecutive chosen intervals must overlap or touch, not just sit at adjacent integers. It reduces to minimum interval covering, solved by a jump-game-style farthest-reach greedy.
